title: Source-citation file data/latest.json is 247.6 h old and disagrees with the dashboard it is cited from
detail: data/latest.json is linked from the Flagged for Review page as the source for individual findings, but it was generated 2026-10-15T08:36:13Z — 247.6 hours before this observation, outside the site's own 8-hour bound. At the same moment the dashboard feed (snapshot.json) was 1.6 hours old, so the two artefacts served from the same site disagree. The inventory differs too: 80 rows in the cited artefact against 78 in the feed (17 open rows against 16). A reader following a citation link is handed a different inventory than the dashboard shows. The served bytes are byte-identical (same SHA-256) to the checked-in branch-root data/latest.json generated 2026-10-15T08:36:13Z: the publisher writes the rendered artefacts back to the branch root but never refreshes this source file, so the stale copy is republished unchanged. This does not by itself change any displayed pick — the pages render from snapshot.json — but every citation that points here is out of date.

title: 3 open Hotspawn CS2 fixture(s) have no published pick row
detail: These fixtures are open on Hotspawn now but carry no pick row: 1086697 Projeto do KinGui vs Yawara; 1082858 Ground Zero vs Off Chops; 1082792 HOTU vs The Huns. The dashboard feed shows 13 picks across 16 open rows. Cause: the fixture appeared after the last successful collection, or no rung of the publisher ladder returned a compliant two-way price for it. The next scheduled refresh re-attempts it.

title: 2 open fixture(s) carry a pick that is not a featured market line
detail: Their published pick comes from an explicitly uncalibrated research rung. Every money surface was read at the observation time and returned no compliant two-way price for these exact names: 1082861 Rooster vs Abyssal; 1082793 5star vs 1WIN.

title: 4 esportsbook / betting-line surface(s) refused the runner
detail: Their silence is a limitation of this runner, not proof that no market exists: pinnacle-esports → not JSON: JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0); egamersworld-matches → HTTP 403; ggbet-cs2 → HTTP 403; stake-cs2 → HTTP 403.

title: HLTV spells a team differently for 1086697
detail: Hotspawn lists Projeto do KinGui vs Yawara; the nearest HLTV row is Tropa do KinGui vs Yawara. No alias is asserted without official proof.
